name: Siem Reap

queries.query: Siem Reap Cambodia official cadastral map parcel land registry GIS site:gov.kh
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the Cambodian Ministry of Land Management, Urban Planning and Construction (MLMUPC) electronic cadastral-service page, its linked gdcg.mlmupc.gov.kh service host, and the official Cambodia Gazetteer entry for Siem Reap Municipality. No anonymous parcel feature response was established.

queries.query: សៀមរាប ផែនទីសុរិយោដី ក្បាលដី គេហទំព័រផ្លូវការ
queries.result: Khmer-language discovery identified the official MLMUPC electronic land-information/cadastral service, the official Siem Reap Municipality gazetteer record (ខេត្តសៀមរាប / ក្រុងសៀមរាប), and an official Khmer cadastral-publication result. These establish official land-management and local administrative evidence, but not an anonymous parcel API or downloadable safe parcel geometry for Siem Reap city.

officialSources.observation: Official MLMUPC services page lists electronic cadastral information, land-sale/gift, parcel subdivision/combination, and related land services. It is a service directory, not a public parcel feature response.
Official MLMUPC electronic cadastral-service page links to gdcg.mlmupc.gov.kh. The page exposes the first-party cadastral service route but no parcel schema or public geometry in the fetched HTML.
First-party cadastral-service host linked by MLMUPC; anonymous GET returned HTTP 403. No login was attempted and no bypass was used.
Official Cambodia Gazetteer identifies Siem Reap Municipality and lists its 12 sangkat administrative units. This is administrative reference evidence, not cadastral parcel geometry.

requests.outcome: Fetched successfully; current page listed the electronic cadastral information service and linked service routes. No parcel geometry or API schema was present in the page.
Fetched successfully; page linked to https://gdcg.mlmupc.gov.kh/. No parcel geometry or safe field schema was present in the fetched page.
Anonymous request was forbidden by the first-party host. No credentials, private token, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, or TLS exception was used.
The related official cadastral service host listed by MLMUPC returned 403 to an anonymous GET. No login or bypass was attempted.
The official land-registration-progress service host listed by MLMUPC returned 403 to an anonymous GET; no private or owner-related fields were requested.
Fetched official administrative gazetteer record for Siem Reap Municipality; no parcel geometry or parcel identity was returned.

registryBasis: A Cambodian national land-management custodian and an official Siem Reap administrative record are evidenced, but no anonymous city-bounded cadastral map/API response, safe parcel identity, schema, CRS, or geometry was verified. The 403 responses do not establish absence.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: MLMUPC electronic cadastral services and the NCDD official Siem Reap Municipality gazetteer record.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: No city-bounded Siem Reap parcel record, stable native parcel identity, schema, CRS, or geometry was retrieved.

remainingUncertainty: The cadastral service's current viewer/API route, access policy, city coverage, schema, CRS, and parcel identity remain unknown because linked first-party service hosts rejected anonymous GETs. A zero exact-point result, extent miss, timeout, or access denial was not used as evidence of citywide cadastral absence.
